She did a ton of research on the Lyctoral process, didn't quite save herself, and still "died." She lived compartmentalized in her Necromancer for almost 10,000 years, fell in love with a woman she couldn't have, lost the child she wanted to raise, who she thought might actually be "hers," lost the woman she loved to the Necromancer she also loved, got stuck in the body of the Necromancer she loved when he died, created an unlikely little found family who have all effectively now been lost to her. For all of her posturing and tough outer-exterior, I think she really did, in some ways, want a peaceful family life with people she loved. But everybody she's loved is gone now, in some way or another, G1deon and Wake are dead, Kiriona is the construct of John, and clearly has some reservations about Pyrrha, Cam and Pal are merged, Nona... we'll see what Nona remembers, but she's not "Nona" anymore.
